description: This file declares functions and structures related to reftable writing, including setting hashes, creating writers that output to buffers, and writing records and logs to buffers. It is part of a project that manages reftable data structures, likely for a version control system.

methods.name: cl_reftable_set_hash
methods.description: Sets a hash value at a specified position within a hash array, identified by an enum hash identifier.

methods.name: cl_reftable_strbuf_writer
methods.description: Creates and returns a reftable writer that outputs to a given buffer with specified options.

methods.name: cl_reftable_write_to_buf
methods.description: Writes reference and log records to the provided buffer using specified options.
